# SvelteForge

A SvelteKit addon that provides a complete UI component library and starter templates built on Skeleton UI v4 and Tailwind CSS v4.

## Templates

### Base
UI-only starter with components and theme. No auth, no database.

### Fullstack
Complete starter with auth (Better Auth), database (Drizzle + SQLite), and admin dashboard.

## Install

```bash
# Create a new project with SvelteForge
npx sv create my-app --template minimal --types ts
cd my-app
npx sv add @ludoloops/svelteforge
```

Choose **base** (UI only) or **fullstack** (UI + auth + admin).

## Quick Start — Base

After installation, you get:

- **15 UI components** — Button, Card, Badge, Avatar, Alert, Input, Select, Textarea, Checkbox, Toggle, ThemeToggle, Accordion, Tabs, Table, Breadcrumb
- **3 layout components** — Navbar (responsive), Footer, AdminLayout (sidebar + topbar)
- **SvelteForge theme** — custom oklch color palette (steel blue primary, burnt orange secondary)
- **Tailwind v4 custom utilities** — spacing, radius, and width tokens via `@theme`
- **Demo page** at `/demo-ui` showcasing all components

## Quick Start — Fullstack

Everything from Base, plus:

- **Better Auth** — email/password login, session management, protected routes
- **Drizzle + SQLite** — schema auto-generated, `db:push` to create tables
- **Admin dashboard** `/admin` — stats cards (users, sessions, new this week)
- **User CRUD** `/admin/users` — create, edit, delete, search, toggle email verification
- **Settings** `/admin/settings` — change password
- **Auth guard** — unprotected routes redirect to `/login`

### Fullstack setup

```bash
cp .env.example .env    # Configure DATABASE_URL, ORIGIN, BETTER_AUTH_SECRET
bun run db:push          # Create database tables
bun run dev              # Start dev server
# Visit /login and sign up
```

## Components

Every component uses `cn()` (clsx + tailwind-merge) and accepts a `class` prop for easy customization:

```svelte
<script>
  import { Button, Card } from '$lib/components/ui';
</script>

<Button variant="filled" color="primary" size="lg">
  Get Started
</Button>

<Card variant="elevated">
  <h2>Hello World</h2>
</Card>
```

### Button Variants
`filled` · `outlined` · `tonal` · `ghost` · `glass` · `elevated`
Colors: `primary` · `secondary` · `tertiary` · `success` · `warning` · `error`

### Card Variants
`flat` · `elevated` · `outlined`

## Theming

Colors are defined as oklch CSS variables in `src/routes/layout.css`. To change the palette, edit the `[data-theme='svelteForge']` block.

Custom Tailwind utilities via `@theme`:
- `p-section` / `p-group` / `p-element` — spacing
- `rounded-card` / `rounded-modal` — radius
- `max-w-modal` / `max-w-toast` / `max-w-container` — widths

## Architecture

### Base
- `src/lib/components/ui/` — 15 UI components
- `src/lib/components/layout/` — Navbar, Footer, AdminLayout
- `src/lib/utils/cn.ts` — class merging utility
- `src/routes/layout.css` — theme + Tailwind config

### Fullstack (extends Base)
- `src/lib/server/auth.ts` — Better Auth config
- `src/lib/server/db/` — Drizzle schema (user, session, account, verification)
- `src/lib/client/auth.ts` — Auth client (sign in, sign out)
- `src/routes/login/` — Login page
- `src/routes/(app)/admin/` — Dashboard, Users CRUD, Settings
- `src/hooks.server.ts` — Session handling + Better Auth middleware

## Stack

| Layer | Technology |
|-------|-----------|
| Framework | SvelteKit 2.x + Svelte 5.x |
| Styling | Tailwind CSS v4 + Skeleton UI v4 |
| Auth | Better Auth v1.x |
| Database | Drizzle ORM + libsql (SQLite) |
| Icons | Phosphor Icons |
| Build | Vite 8.x |
